_about: Ethanol (1) + water (2): excess molar enthalpy at 298.15 K and 323.15 K and 101 kPa, measured as the test system of Nagamachi and Francesconi (2006). Rows as in the ThermoML Archive record: temperature in K, mole fraction of ethanol, excess molar enthalpy in kJ/mol (as printed).

source.citation: M. Y. Nagamachi, A. Z. Francesconi, Measurement and correlation of excess molar enthalpy for (1,2-propanediol, or 1,3-propanediol, or 1,4-butanediol + water) at the temperatures (298.15, 323.15, and 343.15) K, J. Chem. Thermodyn. 38 (2006) 461-466
source.access: Journal article is subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 4: ethanol + water, excess molar enthalpy, variables temperature and mole fraction of ethanol, constraint P = 101 kPa. The table number in the article was not checked (article not open).

notes: Expanded uncertainties in the record: 0.002 to 0.02 kJ/mol. The set is the calorimeter test system of the article (the propanediol and butanediol sets of the record are not transcribed). Values as stored in the ThermoML record (XML file), extracted with validation/python/thermoml_read.py; nothing converted or rounded. To be checked by a person against the record before use (AGENTS.md rule 4).
